import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from scipy.ndimage import maximum_filter
from scipy.signal import correlate2d
import json
D=json.load(open('predictions.json'))
def put(n,label,x,y):D.setdefault(f'fig_{n:03}.png',[]).append({'label':label,'x':[round(float(v),6) for v in x],'y':[round(float(v),7) for v in y]})
def rings(n,color,box,r,threshold,sep):
 im=Image.open('zoom_%03d.png'%n).convert('RGB');a=np.array(im);R,G,B=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
 mask=((B>R+50)&(B>G+50)) if color=='blue' else (a.min(2)<160)
 # avoid uint overflow
 if color=='blue':mask=(B.astype(float)-R>70)&(B.astype(float)-G>70)
 yy,xx=np.mgrid[-8:9,-8:9];dist=np.sqrt(xx*xx+yy*yy);ker=((dist>r-.8)&(dist<r+.8)).astype(float);ker/=ker.sum()
 score=correlate2d(mask.astype(float),ker,mode='same');x0,y0,x1,y1=box
 valid=np.zeros(mask.shape,bool);valid[y0:y1,x0:x1]=True
 peak=(score==maximum_filter(score,size=sep))&(score>threshold)&valid
 ys,xs=np.where(peak);order=np.argsort(-score[ys,xs]);pts=[]
 for k in order:
  x,y=xs[k],ys[k]
  if all((x-u)**2+(y-v)**2>sep**2 for u,v in pts):pts.append((x,y))
 pts.sort();draw=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 for x,y in pts:draw.ellipse((x-2,y-2,x+2,y+2),fill='lime')
 im.save('det_%03d.png'%n);print(n,len(pts));return pts
p=rings(45,'black',(111,80,968,600),5.8,.5,4)
put(45,'UPdGe',[(x-108)*300/(964-108) for x,y in p],[(184-y)*2/(300-184) for x,y in p])
p=rings(66,'blue',(93,40,973,550),5.8,.45,3)
put(66,'URuGe',[2*(300/2)**((x-93)/(970-93)) for x,y in p],[(313-y)*5/(401-313) for x,y in p])
json.dump(D,open('predictions.json','w'),indent=2)
PY
